speaker: M
text: Thank you both for coming. Everything said here stays in this room. Who would like to start?

speaker: A
text: I will. The shift schedule was changed three times last month and nobody asked me.

speaker: B
text: That is not true, we sent the schedule a week ahead.

speaker: A
text: A week ahead is not asking. You always decide alone.

speaker: B
text: You never answer the group chat, so how would we ask you?

speaker: M
text: Let me stop here for a moment. A, what would asking look like for you?

speaker: A
text: A short call before the plan is final. Two minutes would be enough.

speaker: B
text: Two minutes with twelve people is two hours a week.

speaker: B
text: And frankly this is my final offer, the schedule stays.

speaker: A
text: Then I have nothing to talk about here.

speaker: M
text: I hear that both of you care about the schedule working. B, could the plan go out as a draft first?

speaker: B
text: A draft two days before, with comments closing on Friday. I can accept that.

speaker: A
text: That works for me, if I get the draft by email and not only in the chat.

speaker: M
text: So we agree: draft by email two days before, comments until Friday. Weekend swaps we still need to come back to later.

speaker: B
text: Yes. We agree on the draft. Swaps are open.
